title: RidePayload
description: Payload of every ride.events message (RIDE_REQUESTED, DRIVER_ASSIGNED, NO_DRIVER_FOUND, DRIVER_ARRIVED, RIDE_STARTED, RIDE_COMPLETED, RIDE_CANCELLED). Mirrors com.rydex.events.RidePayload. Fields that do not apply to an event type are null. Consumers must ignore unknown fields.

fare.description: INR. Estimated fare, or the final fare on RIDE_COMPLETED.

reason.description: Cancel reason (RIDE_CANCELLED) or why matching gave up (NO_DRIVER_FOUND).

cancellationFee.description: RIDE_CANCELLED only: INR the rider pays for cancelling after the driver arrived (payment-service charges it). Null when the cancellation is free.

simulated.description: Booked by an automated (NPC) rider of the living city (ADR 0016): payment-service charges it through the mock provider. Null (older events) means false.
